content: abduco/dtach minimal model: one detached server process per session (reparented to init) holding the PTY master, clients attach via per-session unix socket; NO terminal emulation and NO scrollback - reattach just starts streaming, redraw relies on app (^L or run dvtm inside); abduco keeps session exit status and reports it on reattach even after process death; read-only attach -r is advisory client-side only (real security = unidirectional socat proxy); resize accepted only from most recently connected non-read-only client; socket recreation via SIGUSR1.
